items.title: Disney (DIS) Stock Looks Fairly Valued As Cash Flow Holds Up
items.summary: Walt Disney shares have climbed in recent years, and with the stock recently around a 52 week high, investors are asking whether the current price still lines up with the cash the business can generate. With Disney pushing through cost cuts and reinvestment at the same time, the question now is how those choices feed into the cash flows that matter most for valuation.
